evidence: Commit message: 'Followup to #35395.' (#35395 was merged to improve test suite dependency documentation).

result.card: Adds `plyvel` to the optional test suite dependencies table in `test/README.md`, covering package installation via pip and Debian/Ubuntu for DB corruption tests. It follows up on merged PR #35395 to keep dependency guidance complete. The PR affects only documentation and has low risk.

risk.why: A typo in documentation would at worst misinform developers installing test dependencies.
